Baptist Missions to Forgotten Peoples (bmfp.org) - HIT. Static WordPress-style site, one page per missionary unit at bmfp.org/missionaries/<slug>/. Slug shape is inconsistent (<first>-<first>-<surname> and <surname>-<first>-<first> both occur) but always carries the surname. Page titles are 'SURNAME, FIRST & FIRST'. Mined.

Prayer Baptist Missions International (prayerbaptistmissions.com) - PARTIAL. Per-person profiles exist at /my-profile/pbmi/<namesmashed>/ but the directory sits behind /missionary-login/ and only one profile is indexed. Worth a logged-out fetch pass to see whether a public roster exists.

Beacon Int'l Baptist Mission (beaconibm.com) - MISS. Only About/Beliefs/Give/Get-Involved/Contact pages indexed; no missionary roster and no per-person path. Site states plainly that no BIBM missionary receives an agency salary and each family raises support from independent Baptist churches (org_policy), but it names nobody. Candidate for a fetch pass, not for search.

Vision Baptist Missions - MISS on this surface. visionbaptistmissions.com redirects/resolves to visionmissions.com; /missionaries there is a single navigation hub page (Foreign / Stateside / Helps pathways) with no indexed per-person child pages. A third-party page, dearvisionbaptist.com/current-list-of-vbm-missionaries/, appears to carry a name list - worth a fetch pass, but it is not the agency's own surface.
Independent Baptist Fellowship International (ibfi.us) - not probed, already worked per BRIEF. Noted only because discovery search kept surfacing it.
